evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a native or cross-platform mobile application for Android and iOS devices.

issues.explanation: The phrase permits multiple implementation interpretations and does not define a single required behavior or constraint. A requirement should specify one clear expectation.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide a mobile application that operates on Android and iOS devices.

issues.detected_issue: provide a native or cross-platform mobile application
issues.explanation: This statement describes a solution approach or architectural implementation choice rather than an externally verifiable functional behavior. It is better expressed as a platform support constraint.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall operate on Android 12 or later and iOS 16 or later.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to register, log in, maintain an authenticated session, and log out from the app startup flow.

issues.detected_issue: register, log in, maintain an authenticated session, and log out
issues.explanation: The statement combines four distinct capabilities into one requirement. Each capability should be specified separately to ensure singularity and traceable verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to register an account from the app startup flow.

issues.explanation: The phrase is unclear as a condition or context and does not cleanly follow the standard requirement structure for each behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a registered user to log in from the app startup screen.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow authenticated users to select, update, and remove favorite football clubs.

issues.explanation: The requirement contains three separate user actions. ISO 29148 prefers one requirement per distinct action for testability and traceability.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow an authenticated user to add a football club to the user's favorites list.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to select and manage preferred sports channels used for personalized news and content filtering.

issues.explanation: The phrase combines at least two separate capabilities. "Manage" is also broad and may include multiple actions such as update and remove.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to select preferred sports channels for news filtering.

issues.explanation: The term is vague because it does not identify the exact operations the system must support.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to add and remove preferred sports channels for content filtering.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display current football news relevant to a user's favorite teams and selected sports channels.

issues.explanation: The term is vague because it does not define a time window or refresh criterion for included news.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news published within the last 24 hours for a user's favorite teams and selected sports channels.

issues.explanation: The term is subjective and may be interpreted differently unless explicit filtering logic is defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news tagged to a user's favorite teams or selected sports channels.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a news detail view containing article title, source, publication time, body summary, related team tags, and share action.

issues.detected_issue: article title, source, publication time, body summary, related team tags, and share action
issues.explanation: The requirement bundles multiple content elements and an additional interactive function into a single statement. These should be separated or expressed as a defined view composition requirement and a separate sharing requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display a news detail view that includes the article title, source, publication time, body summary, and related team tags.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall retrieve live match data from an external server API through the live ticker module.
The system shall display live scores, match clock, status, and chronological match events for selected favorite-team matches.

issues.detected_issue: live scores, match clock, status, and chronological match events
issues.explanation: The requirement includes multiple distinct display obligations in one statement. Splitting these elements improves traceability and verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display the live score for each selected favorite-team match.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall continuously update live ticker information while a match is active and network connectivity is available.

issues.explanation: The phrase is vague because it does not define the refresh interval or update trigger, making objective verification difficult.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall refresh live ticker information every 10 seconds while a match is active and network connectivity is available.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall present national and international leagues and competitions with associated fixtures, results, and teams.

issues.explanation: The requirement aggregates multiple data presentation obligations into one statement. Separate requirements would be easier to verify.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display a list of national and international leagues and competitions.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide searchable team profiles including overview, fixtures, recent results, squad list, and key statistics.

issues.detected_issue: searchable team profiles including overview, fixtures, recent results, squad list, and key statistics
issues.explanation: The requirement combines search capability with multiple profile content obligations. These are distinct behaviors and should be separated.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to search for a team profile by team name.

issues.explanation: The term is vague because it does not identify which statistics are mandatory.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display team profiles with overview, fixtures, recent results, squad list, and season statistics for wins, losses, draws, and goals scored.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide player profiles including biography, team, position, nationality, and performance statistics where data is available.

issues.explanation: The term is underspecified because it does not define which statistics must be shown.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display player profiles with biography, current team, position, nationality, appearances, goals, and assists.

issues.explanation: This escape clause weakens the obligation and leaves behavior unspecified when data is missing.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display an unavailable-data indicator for any player profile field that is not returned by the data source.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display live-stream provider links only after the live broadcast has begun.
The system shall evaluate country-specific transmission-rights rules before displaying any live-stream provider link.

issues.explanation: The phrase is broad and does not define the rule source, decision logic, or measurable outcome. Verification requires explicit input and output conditions.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall check the user's country code against the configured transmission-rights rule set before displaying a live-stream provider link.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall hide or disable unavailable live-stream links and explain that the stream is not available in the user's country or has not started.

issues.explanation: The requirement allows two different behaviors, which creates ambiguity and prevents a single objective verification outcome.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall disable a live-stream link when the stream is unavailable.

issues.detected_issue: not available in the user's country or has not started
issues.explanation: The requirement merges multiple conditions and a generic explanation. The expected message behavior should be explicit for each condition.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display the message "Stream unavailable in your country" when transmission-rights rules block the stream.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to enable, disable, and configure notification categories for favorite-team news and results.

issues.explanation: The requirement combines multiple independent actions into one statement. Each action should be a separate requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to enable notifications for favorite-team news.

issues.explanation: The phrase is vague because it does not specify what configuration options are supported.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to enable or disable each notification category for favorite-team news and match results.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall send notifications for configured current events when the notification function is activated and operating-system permission is granted.

issues.explanation: The phrase is unclear because it does not define which event types are in scope.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall send a notification for a favorite-team match result when that notification category is enabled and operating-system permission is granted.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague and does not identify the exact state or setting being checked.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall send notifications only when the user has enabled the corresponding notification category and operating-system permission is granted.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to share news articles and match reports through device-supported social media and messaging channels.

issues.explanation: The requirement includes two separate content-sharing scopes. These may be split if independently verified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to share a news article through a device-supported application.

issues.detected_issue: device-supported social media and messaging channels
issues.explanation: The term is broad and environment-dependent. The requirement should define the mechanism more precisely.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall invoke the device share sheet to share a news article or match report.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded core content including favorites, recent news summaries, recent results, and team/player profiles.

issues.explanation: The phrase is vague and should be replaced by an explicit list of content types.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded favorites, recent news summaries, recent results, team profiles, and player profiles.

issues.explanation: The term is ambiguous because it does not define a time period or item limit.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to the 20 most recently loaded news summaries and the 20 most recently loaded match results.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall collect in-app feedback or direct users to app review channels so that feedback can be evaluated for continuous improvement.

issues.detected_issue: collect in-app feedback or direct users to app review channels
issues.explanation: The use of "or" permits different implementations and does not specify one required system behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide an in-app feedback form that allows a user to submit textual feedback.

issues.detected_issue: so that feedback can be evaluated for continuous improvement
issues.explanation: This clause expresses a business objective rather than a verifiable system behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall store each submitted feedback entry with timestamp and app version.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall complete cold-start loading and render the first usable screen within 2 seconds on supported Android and iOS devices under normal network conditions.

issues.detected_issue: complete cold-start loading and render the first usable screen
issues.explanation: The requirement contains two linked outcomes that may need separate verification criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall render the first usable screen within 2 seconds of application launch on supported Android and iOS devices under defined test network conditions.

issues.explanation: The term is subjective unless the target screen and usability criterion are defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall render the home screen with interactive navigation controls within 2 seconds of application launch on supported Android and iOS devices under defined test network conditions.

issues.explanation: The phrase is vague because it does not define measurable network parameters for verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall render the home screen with interactive navigation controls within 2 seconds of application launch when tested at 50 Mbps downlink latency not exceeding 50 ms.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall maintain smooth interaction performance with no more than 100 milliseconds average UI response latency for common navigation and preference actions on supported devices.

issues.explanation: This is subjective wording and is unnecessary because the measurable latency target already defines the quality constraint.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall achieve an average UI response latency of no more than 100 milliseconds for defined navigation and preference actions on supported devices.

issues.explanation: The phrase is vague because the specific actions to be measured are not identified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall achieve an average UI response latency of no more than 100 milliseconds for opening the home screen, opening the favorites screen, selecting a team, and updating notification preferences on supported devices.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall support at least 100,000 simultaneous users on match days without material degradation of login, news, live ticker, and notification services.

issues.explanation: The phrase is contextual and does not define the exact load-test period or environment.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 simultaneous active sessions during peak-load test conditions.

issues.explanation: This phrase is subjective and not measurable without explicit service-level thresholds.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 simultaneous active sessions while maintaining login response time below 2 seconds, news API response time below 3 seconds, live ticker refresh intervals within 10 seconds, and notification delivery initiation within 30 seconds.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall maintain 99.5% monthly availability for core services excluding planned maintenance windows.

issues.explanation: The term is vague because it does not enumerate which services are covered by the availability target.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall maintain 99.5% monthly availability for the authentication, news, live ticker, and notification services, excluding planned maintenance windows.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall remain navigable and shall provide access to cached favorites, recent news, recent scores, and saved profiles when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.detected_issue: shall remain navigable and shall provide access
issues.explanation: The statement contains two separate obligations: navigation behavior and offline content access. They should be specified separately.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide access to cached favorites, recent news, recent scores, and saved profiles when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.explanation: The term is subjective and does not define which screens or actions must remain available offline.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow the user to open the home, favorites, and profile screens when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.explanation: The term "recent" is vague because no time range or item count is specified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide access to the 20 most recently cached news items and the 20 most recently cached scores when network connectivity is unavailable.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall detect network loss within 5 seconds and display a clear offline or reconnecting status without terminating the user session.

issues.detected_issue: detect network loss within 5 seconds and display
issues.explanation: The statement combines detection, status presentation, and session-preservation behavior into one requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall detect loss of network connectivity within 5 seconds of connection interruption.

issues.explanation: The word "clear" is subjective, and "offline or reconnecting" permits multiple outputs without defined conditions.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display the status message "Offline" within 1 second after network loss is detected.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall process personal data in compliance with GDPR, including lawful basis, transparency, consent management where required, data minimization, retention controls, and user rights handling.

issues.explanation: This is a broad regulatory objective rather than a directly testable system behavior. Compliance must be decomposed into concrete, verifiable requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall record the timestamp, purpose, and version of the privacy notice for each user consent event.

issues.detected_issue: including lawful basis, transparency, consent management where required, data minimization, retention controls, and user rights handling
issues.explanation: The requirement merges multiple distinct compliance obligations into one compound statement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to withdraw previously granted consent for optional personal-data processing.

issues.explanation: This escape clause leaves the applicability undefined and weakens verifiability.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall request user consent before processing personal data for optional analytics.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall encrypt personal data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and shall encrypt sensitive personal data at rest using industry-standard encryption.

issues.detected_issue: encrypt personal data in transit ... and ... encrypt sensitive personal data at rest
issues.explanation: The statement contains two distinct security constraints that should be separated for traceability and verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall encrypt personal data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague because it does not identify a specific algorithm or accepted standard.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall encrypt sensitive personal data at rest using AES-256.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall validate and sanitize all external API responses before rendering them in the user interface to preserve module consistency and prevent malformed content from disrupting the app.

issues.explanation: The statement combines two separate processing actions that may require independent verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall validate each external API response against the defined response schema before rendering it in the user interface.

issues.detected_issue: to preserve module consistency and prevent malformed content from disrupting the app
issues.explanation: This rationale states desired outcomes rather than measurable required behavior. It is not needed in the requirement text.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall reject any external API response that fails schema validation before rendering it in the user interface.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall refresh active live ticker data at least every 10 seconds where supported by the external data provider and connectivity conditions.

issues.detected_issue: where supported by the external data provider and connectivity conditions
issues.explanation: This escape clause makes the requirement conditional on undefined external circumstances and weakens verifiability.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall refresh active live ticker data every 10 seconds when the external data provider endpoint is reachable and the device has network connectivity.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA-aligned mobile accessibility expectations for color contrast, text scaling, focus order, and screen-reader labels on core screens.

issues.explanation: The phrase is imprecise because "aligned" and "expectations" do not establish a strict, testable conformance target.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA success criteria for color contrast, text resizing, focus order, and non-text labels on the defined core screens.

issues.explanation: The term is vague because the applicable screens are not enumerated.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA success criteria for color contrast, text resizing, focus order, and non-text labels on the home, favorites, news detail, live ticker, and profile screens.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall log client and service errors in a privacy-preserving manner and shall make diagnostic information available to support teams for pre-release testing and post-release issue resolution.

issues.detected_issue: shall log client and service errors ... and shall make diagnostic information available
issues.explanation: The requirement combines logging behavior and information access behavior into two separate obligations.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall log client and service errors.

issues.explanation: This phrase is subjective unless explicit data-handling constraints are defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall exclude usernames, email addresses, access tokens, and full IP addresses from client and service error logs.

issues.detected_issue: diagnostic information available to support teams
issues.explanation: The phrase does not define what information is available, by what mechanism, or to which authorized roles.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide authorized support personnel read-only access to error logs, timestamps, app version, device type, and stack traces through the support dashboard.
